Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add per-connection project tracking for multi-tab support

Server now watches all registered projects simultaneously and only
broadcasts file change events to clients viewing that specific project.
Each SSE connection tracks which project it''s watching, enabling
multiple browser tabs to view different projects independently.

Key changes:
- watcher.js: Multi-project watching with filtered broadcasts
- SSE endpoint accepts ?project= param for per-connection tracking
- Frontend passes projectId to useTasks and panel hooks
- Notes/Roadmap panels only create SSE connections when open
  \(fixes browser connection limit exhaustion\)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
